transfer_items.claim: Dependency-aware VLIW bundle packing (greedy in-order packing of the topologically sorted slot stream with per-engine capacity limits alu=12/valu=6/load=2/store=2/flow=1 and RAW/WAR/WAW scratch-overlap flush, debug slots as barriers) combined with VALU vectorization of contiguous loads, hash stages, parity/child selection and stores across VLEN=8 lanes — with the irregular forest lookup kept as 8 scalar address+load ops gathered into one contiguous scratch range per group — cut cycles from 147734 to 6896 (21.4231x, target 8.0x)
transfer_items.actionable_hint: Keep the never-reordering greedy packer (capacity + hazard flush only) as the scheduling skeleton for any further variant: it preserves the simulator's end-of-cycle write semantics while filling all engines; further gains should come from reducing scalar gather count or reordering the phase-grouped stream, not from reordering within bundles.

transfer_items.claim: The winning kernel assumes batch_size is VLEN-aligned (batch_size % 8 == 0): it tiles the batch into groups of 8 lanes with unmasked vload/vstore and vector bounds-wrapping; correctness is verified only at forest_height=10, rounds=16, batch_size=256 (32 full groups, no tail)
transfer_items.actionable_hint: Before reusing this kernel at any non-VLEN-aligned batch_size, add a masked tail group or a scalar epilogue for the final batch_size % 8 lanes and re-run the 8-iteration correctness suite; scratch sizing (1536-word limit) must also be re-derived if rounds/groups change since per-group ranges are reused across rounds.

transfer_items.claim: Remaining cycle cost is dominated by the ISA's lack of a vector gather: the data-dependent forest lookup costs 8 scalar address ALU ops + 8 scalar loads per vector group against a load-engine limit of 2 slots/cycle, so the 32-group × 16-round gather sequence is the main residual between the measured 6896 cycles and the ~2139-cycle design intent claimed (unmeasured) for the Aug-18 32x8-lane schedule
transfer_items.actionable_hint: Attack the gather bound directly: precompute or cache forest node values across rounds where indices repeat, fold the address add into load_offset slots to free ALU issue slots, or restructure so multiple groups' scalar gathers interleave with vector hash work to saturate both load slots every cycle; validate each variant with the anchored CYCLES benchmark.
